subtitle: Naming the convention Chapters 5 and 6 have been building toward

code:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reporting.vw_sales_by_customer AS
SELECT c.customer_name, c.region, s.sale_date, s.sale_amount
FROM warehouse.fact_sales AS s
JOIN warehouse.dim_customer AS c
    ON s.customer_key = c.customer_key
   AND c.is_current = TRUE;
caption: The is_current filter is where SCD2 pays off — invisibly, to whoever writes the report.
